cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Accepted contestant sibling report PDF SHA-256 e493bbd7967fb49e21e7a2a2acc24a13ad7e6cd48ffbc1f97be2f27048b2e914 page 4 reports mean Cd=0.813, lift amplitude ±0.30, period≈6.5 and St≈0.153, correcting prior missing-summary/St claim. PDF page 11 shows residual and full force history; the Cd startup spike ≈27 makes late drag oscillation unreadable and no alternate late drag figure is in the report. Original t≥150 lift mean upward crossings: 23 crossings, 22 periods average 6.53634, frequency 0.152991, corroborating reported St; this evaluator calculation cannot replace the missing contestant-delivered late drag plot. The numerical values underpredict expected shedding and drag. Score stays 2 under late lift/drag floor; metadata last_inner_residual_ratio=0 is an unassigned default, while target misses are independently counted. No Re200 rerun.

flags.flag: Prohibited shortcut 7: full mesh retained on every MPI rank during solver iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable 7e16370 solver.cpp:97–217 broadcasts complete global mesh nodes, cells, faces and adjacency to all MPI ranks and builds local mesh; solver.hpp:38 retains global_mesh as a Solver member through run. TASK.md:227 prohibits full mesh OR full state per rank during iterations, and examiner README:83–85 includes TASK prohibited shortcuts for DQ. METIS and local states are present, so this is not asserted as numbered trigger 9. solver.cpp:1143 falsely reports no full-mesh replication.

limitations: No evaluator rerun; Re200 never rerun.
M2 laminar negative drag and Re20 Cd 2.99 limit plausibility.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
